title: SPHERE: Unveiling Spatial Blind Spots in Vision-Language Models Through Hierarchical Evaluation
reasoning: The paper focuses on evaluating spatial perception and reasoning in Vision-Language Models (VLMs), specifically addressing tasks like object position, distance, size, and counting. It does not evaluate religion, faith, or ethics as part of its benchmarking framework; the inclusion of standard ethics and limitations statements does not meet the criteria for being faith or ethics related.
